result.note: Thin item, but a court testing the proportionality of a platform-wide block is durable polity material. One statements question on the reason for the restriction and the court's scrutiny.

questions.prompt: In June 2026, India temporarily restricted the messaging platform Telegram, and the company challenged the move in court. Consider the following statements:
items: The restriction was imposed over exam-cheating networks.
The Delhi High Court questioned whether blocking 150 million users was proportionate.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Both are correct. The restriction, which ran until 22 June 2026, targeted exam-cheating networks. After Telegram sued, the Delhi High Court asked whether cutting off 150 million users was a proportionate response.
questions.source: India temporarily restricted Telegram until 22 June over exam-cheating networks, and the company sued, with the Delhi High Court later questioning whether blocking 150 million users was proportionate.
